items.summary: In the “Data Storage” section, explain that selections remain locally on the device and can be reset anytime.
In the “Medical Disclaimer” section, clarify the app is only a communication tool and not medical advice.
In the “Third-Party Services” section, state there are no ads, no analytics SDKs, no tracking, and no third-party sharing.
In the “Changes” section, state the policy will update if app features change.
In the “Contact” section, include the placeholder email address exactly: support@myhealthbuddy.app
In the “Ownership” section, include exactly: “© Gabriella Gayle — My Health Buddy and Luma character are original creations.”
Update the grown-ups navigation label that opens the privacy page to match the new page purpose by changing the button text from “Privacy & Safety” to “Privacy Policy” in the Grown-ups Area.

Replace the existing “Privacy & Safety” grown-ups page content with a legally compliant Privacy Policy page for a children’s app, keeping a gentle, friendly tone and short, parent-readable paragraphs, suitable for worldwide use.

Update the page title to exactly “Privacy Policy – My Health Buddy” and render the policy as clearly separated sections with headings in this exact order: No Personal Data Collection, Offline Use, Children’s Privacy, Data Storage, Medical Disclaimer, Third-Party Services, Changes, Contact, Ownership.

In the “No Personal Data Collection” section, state clearly that the app does NOT collect names, email, location, contacts, photos, microphone recordings, health data, analytics, identifiers, cookies, or tracking, using plain language.
In the “Offline Use” section, explain that the app works completely offline and nothing leaves the device.
In the “Children’s Privacy” section, state the app is designed for children with parent/teacher/carer supervision and complies with COPPA and GDPR-K because no personal data is collected.
